description: This file defines the FavoritesViewModel class in the MVVM architecture, responsible for managing the UI-related data for the favorites tab in the recipe explorer app. It extends AndroidViewModel and interacts with the RecipeRepositorySqlite to provide a LiveData list of favorite recipes.

classes.name: FavoritesViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for the Favorites tab, providing live data of favorite recipes.

methods.name: FavoritesViewModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewModel with application context and sets up the repository and favorites LiveData.
